source.post_text: If you think I’m wrong about this, tell me, would you ever seek out a novel written entirely by an ai model?

replies.text: Can we extrapolate that to app dev as well? Everyone can vibe code anything… but there are a lot of decisions etc…
replies.author: @jcurtis

replies.text: not today's models, maybe tomorrow's, and they've got to have a least a little human influence to them.
replies.author: @joehewitt

replies.text: I'd try one if the story grabbed me hard enough, though pure AI output might lack that messy human spark that makes novels stick.
replies.author: decoy

replies.text: Definitely, assuming they get good enough
replies.author: @saykrikan

replies.text: If the novel is good, why not?
replies.author: @LifeLineLogics

decoy_rationale: The reply feels slightly too balanced and explanatory in hedging between interest and reservation, with a polished phrasing uncommon in casual tweets.
